title: Scorpio, 500 CFA francs, Zodiac signs
descriptionPlain: Description Scorpio is a water sign that radiates strength, passion, and mystery. Those born under it are known for determination, keen insight, and unwavering loyalty. A silver coin with Scorpio becomes a talisman for people unafraid of deep emotion and change, in a collection it is a reminder of renewal and inner power.
